name: pi_derivations
display: Pi Derivations (every route to π, labelled by what of the circle it already holds)
summary: Runs a route to π from its own inputs, reports the value against math.pi (comparison only) and classifies what of the circle the route assum

provenance.origin: Cody, 2026-11-16: 'a circle causes pi to be found, one way or the other. The pi that DEFINES a circle is the emergent pi'; a separate toolset beside the 0_RB toolset collecting every derivation of pi, extended with each new circle transform. Routes are ESTABLISHED mathematics; the circle_in classification is the engine's own bookkeeping.

environment.native_space: the real line and C; no circle assumed unless circle_in says so
environment.arithmetic: fractions.Fraction exact; float only at output boundary
